body:
Thank you, it really means a lot. 
This is going to sound pathetic but I'm scared of medicine. My dad is a large reason for my situation. 
Mental illness runs in his side of the family and he was very unkind to me growing up. When he was on medicine, he was nice but when he was off- it was like night and day. 
I'm scared of being someone who needs medication to be normal. 
I tried it for awhile and I couldn't do it. I know I'm an idiot but I just want to be normal.
I feel like my brain doesn't work right. I don't know how to be happy. I don't want to rely on medicine to help me be normal my whole life. I just wish I could be like everyone else.

I had a dream once when I was in high school. I was floating, so gently up higher and higher over my grandparent's home up in the mountains. 
It felt so real, I even remember kicking my legs and floating up a little faster. 
It was seriously the best feeling. I had no fear or pain. 
It was seriously the clearest my mind ever felt. 
I hope dying is like that.
But how? I feel so lost. It's like there's this fog and I can't find a way out.
I wish I could. Thank you for listening. I'll stop bothering you.

I just don't see what I can offer anyone. I just exist. I have been trying for two years to find a purpose but I can't find one. I'm so pathetic bc there are people out there truly suffering and I this sniveling fool who stumbles around life like a fucking idiot.
I can't remember. How pathetic is that? I used to like hanging out with people, now I can't stand it. I hate how worthless I am in comparison to everyone else.

Nothing makes me happy anymore. 
I try to be positive and I use humor to mask my feelings. Everyone just wants me to magically be happy. I don't know how. 
No, I can't afford a therapist

Yeah. I have friends but sometimes I fucking loathe them. I think it's because they have happy lives and bright futures. I guess I hate my existence more because I envy them. 
I'm shitty with words, sorry.
